mapper.sql: s.id, s.project_id AS projectId, s.batch_id AS batchId, b.batch_name AS batchName, s.sequence_token AS sequenceToken, s.name, s.description, s.frame_count AS frameCount, s.first_frame_id AS firstFrameId, s.last_frame_id AS lastFrameId, s.create_time AS createTime
FROM label_sequence s LEFT JOIN label_asset_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.sequence_id AS sequenceId, f.frame_token AS frameToken, f.frame_index AS frameIndex, f.timestamp_us AS timestampUs, f.prev_frame_id AS prevFrameId, f.next_frame_id AS nextFrameId, f.is_key_frame AS isKeyFrame FROM label_frame f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY f.frame_index

SELECT sd.id, sd.frame_id AS frameId, sd.sensor_id AS sensorId, sd.calibration_id AS calibrationId, sd.ego_pose_id AS egoPoseId, sd.file_name AS fileName, sd.file_url AS fileUrl, sd.file_format AS fileFormat, sd.width, sd.height, sd.is_key_frame AS isKeyFrame, sn.channel, sn.modality FROM label_sensor_data sd LEFT JOIN label_sensor sn ON sn.id = sd.sensor_id WHERE sd.deleted = 0 AND sd.frame_id = #{frameId} ORDER BY sn.channel
SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, channel, modality FROM label_sensor WHERE deleted = 0 AND (project_id = #{projectId} OR project_id IS NULL) ORDER BY id

SELECT c.id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color, cs.name AS classSetName, c.tool_type AS toolType FROM label_class c JOIN label_class_set cs ON cs.id = c.class_set_id WHERE cs.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT ao.object_key AS objectKey, ao.object_type AS type, ao.class_id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$')) AS geometryJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.attr_json, '$')) AS attrJson, ao.track_token AS trackToken, ao.instance_id AS instanceId, ao.visibility FROM label_annotation_object ao LEFT JOIN label_class c ON c.id = ao.class_id WHERE ao.annotation_id = #{annotationId} AND ao.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ao.id
SELECT id FROM label_annotation WHERE deleted = 0 AND frame_id = #{frameId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM label_annotation WHERE deleted = 0 AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} AND frame_id = #{frameId}

SELECT id, sequence_id AS sequenceId, frame_id AS frameId, object_key AS objectKey, error_type AS errorType, error_level AS errorLevel, status, comment, create_time AS createTime FROM label_annotation_error WHERE deleted = 0 AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, sequence_id AS sequenceId, frame_id AS frameId, object_key AS objectKey, check_type AS checkType, message, resolved_flag AS resolvedFlag, create_time AS createTime FROM label_precheck WHERE deleted = 0 AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, sequence_id AS sequenceId, frame_id AS frameId, node, content, status, creator_id AS creatorId, create_time AS createTime FROM label_comment WHERE deleted = 0 AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id FROM label_sensor WHERE deleted = 0 AND project_id = #{projectId} AND channel = #{channel}
SELECT sensor_id FROM label_calibration WHERE id = #{calibrationId}
SELECT id FROM label_instance WHERE deleted = 0 AND project_id = #{projectId} AND instance_token = #{instanceToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_sensor (project_id, channel, modality, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{channel}, #{modality}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM label_calibration WHERE calibration_token = #{token} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM label_ego_pose WHERE pose_token = #{token} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_calibration ( sensor_id, calibration_token, translation, rotation, camera_intrinsic, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES (#{sensorId}, #{token}, #{translation}, #{rotation}, #{cameraIntrinsic}, #{userId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO label_frame ( sequence_id, frame_token, frame_index, timestamp_us, prev_frame_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES (#{sequenceId}, #{token}, #{frameIndex}, #{timestampUs}, #{prevId}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_frame SET next_frame_id = #{frameId} WHERE id = #{prevId}
UPDATE label_sequence SET first_frame_id = #{firstFrameId}, last_frame_id = #{lastFrameId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_annotation (sequence_id, frame_id, version, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{sequenceId}, #{frameId}, 1, 'draft', #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_annotation SET update_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE label_annotation_object SET deleted = 1 WHERE annotation_id = #{annotationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM label_precheck WHERE sequence_id = #{sequenceId} AND frame_id = #{frameId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_comment ( sequence_id, frame_id, node, content, status, creator_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES (#{sequenceId}, #{frameId}, #{node}, #{content}, 'uncorrected', #{creatorId}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE label_annotation_error SET status = 'corrected' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE label_comment SET status = 'corrected' WHERE id = #{id}
